title: Neon Pulse — Episode 29: The Holographic Trap
description: Kael confronts Commander Vance's holographic trap and discovers a deeper conspiracy hiding beneath the surface tier.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The glowing projection flickers and dissolves into empty air. Vance is gone, leaving only a mocking digital echo bouncing off the reinforced concrete walls.
scenes.visual: Low angle shot inside a dark concrete chamber, amber light fading from the center where a digital projection just vanished, empty metal corridors stretching into deep shadows

scenes.narration: My powers surge through the tactical jacket, overloading the nearby security terminals. Sparks cascade across the floor like falling stars.
scenes.visual: Close up of hands generating bright amber energy against a shattered control console, intense blue and orange electrical sparks bouncing off stone flooring in a tight space

scenes.narration: A hidden floor panel rattles open, revealing a dusty ladder descending into total darkness. This wasn't on any of Vance's decrypted schematics.
scenes.visual: Kneeling beside a dark rectangular opening in the metal floor, peering downward into a deep vertical shaft illuminated only by faint amber sleeve glow

scenes.narration: Descending into the sub-basement, the air grows freezing and thick with the hum of forbidden technology. Massive server banks tower into the gloom.
scenes.visual: Looking up from the bottom of a massive industrial chamber filled with towering black server towers humming with dim violet lights in the heavy mist

scenes.narration: Glowing data crystals line the walls, pulsing in a rhythm that matches my own racing heartbeat. Someone built this facility long before Vance ever arrived.
scenes.visual: Reaching out to touch a cluster of jagged purple crystals embedded in a damp rock wall, warm amber energy creeping along the fingers toward the stone surface

scenes.narration: A sudden holographic broadcast activates overhead, showing an unfamiliar symbol blinking in crimson. The voice tells me I was never meant to survive.
scenes.visual: Staring upward with a tense expression as a harsh crimson light washes over the underground cavern from an unseen overhead emitter

scenes.narration: Heavy blast doors begin to seal shut at both ends of the chamber. There is no going back now.
scenes.visual: Quick motion shot of thick steel doors slamming shut in a narrow corridor, throwing up tiny clouds of dust under harsh overhead emergency lighting

scenes.narration: Follow along for the next chapter of Neon Pulse to see how Kael escapes this subterranean labyrinth.
scenes.visual: Cinematic portrait shot facing the camera with a determined expression, surrounded by subtle glowing amber electrical particles drifting slowly in the air
